## XT Pro Ultra

### Spacious, Powerful & Affordable

With new hardware releases demanding more cooling capacity and internal space, the XT-series is designed to deliver just that. And it delivers extremely good value. The length and width of the chassis easily fit even the largest graphics cards with space to spare for cable management. Cooling has been optimized with up to 10x 120 mm fan locations, support for 140 mm fans, and dedicated radiator space in the top of the chassis.

The XT-Series further innovates to bring support for the latest mainboards that host hidden connectors at the rear to unlock that zero-cable setup. The graphics card also benefits from 3x 120 mm fan locations on the mid-plate that provide direct cooling.

- Dedicated top 360 radiator space in the top.

- A total of 10x 120 fans | 6x 140 + 3x 120 fan locations

## Build for the Future

- UNLOCK THE ZERO-CABLE SETUP Mainboards with hidden connectors on the rear-side are fully supported by the XT Pro chassis.
- Support for MSI Project Zero mainboards.
- Support for ASUS BTF mainboards.
- Support for Gigabyte Project Stealth mainboards.

## Packed with Value

- Powerful and cool with 4x D-RGB 140mm fans build in.
- USB-C 3.2 Gen2 for ultra-fast data transfers.

## Integrated D-RGB lighting

- Refined D-RGB lighting effects that just work, no software required
- Optionally sync with motherboard and software

## Multiple Storage Options

## Patterned Magnetic Dustfilters 

Special pattern on the dust filter creates a unique outlook for the chassis.

## Modular I/O Panel 

The I/O panel can be adjusted to six different locations. On both side of the body you can install the I/O panel at the front, top or bottom.

#### Edge-To-Edge Side Panel 

Show off your build through the full size transparent side panel.

#### Multiple Positioning Options 

The case can be put in vertical or horizontal position. 

#### Excellent Thermal Performance 

The open design of the perforated front, top and bottom guarantees excellent thermal performance

#### Clean Routing Space 

Behind the motherboard tray, 28mm of space is offered for cable management.

#### Fan and Radiator Support

The front supports up to two 140mm fans and up to a 240mm radiator. The rear supports a 120mm fan or radiator and the top two 120mm fans. All to ensure you don't have to compromise on performance. 

#### Main Components Clearance

The MasterBox Q300L case supports CPU coolers up to a height of 159mm, graphics cards up to a length of 360mm, and power supplies up to a length of 160mm.
